traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills that are closely spaced, white to cream-colored, often with reddish-brown spots in age.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills that are closely spaced, white to cream-colored, often with reddish-brown spots in age.

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Convex when young, flattening with age and often developing a central depression, smooth, dry, and matte; color varies from reddish-brown to dark brown or almost black.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Convex when young, flattening with age and often developing a central depression, smooth, dry, and matte; color varies from reddish-brown to dark brown or almost black.

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Adnexed to slightly decurrent.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnexed to slightly decurrent.

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical, white or with reddish discolorations, and firm.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, white or with reddish discolorations, and firm.

traits.label: Dimensions
traits.text: Cap: 5-12 cm in diameter.
traits.raw: 📐 Cap: 5-12 cm in diameter.

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruit body: 6-15 cm tall.
traits.raw: 📏 Fruit body: 6-15 cm tall.

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore Print: Creamy white to pale yellow.
traits.raw: 🟡⚪ Spore Print: Creamy white to pale yellow.

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Mycorrhizal, commonly found in coniferous forests.
traits.raw: 🌲 Mycorrhizal, commonly found in coniferous forests.

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Inedible, known to be bitter.
traits.raw: 🍴 Inedible, known to be bitter.

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores 7-9 x 6-7 µm, broadly ellipsoid, with warts connected by thin ridges.
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores 7-9 x 6-7 µm, broadly ellipsoid, with warts connected by thin ridges.

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Mild, not particularly distinctive.
traits.raw: 👃 Mild, not particularly distinctive.

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Identified by its dark-colored cap and contrasting white gills which often develop reddish-brown spots as the mushroom matures. The presence of this mushroom indicates a healthy mycorrhizal relationship within coniferous environments.
